title: feat: parametric headstock outline preview on the Art Studio designer
intent: Port the recovered headstock outline mathematics into the routed Art Studio designer as a design-only preview in 200 by 320 model space. Do not restore the archived suite, bind millimeter fields, or add manufacturing output.
behavior_change: The routed /art-studio/headstock page gains a separate parametric outline panel. Existing template loading and generate-prompt payloads are unchanged.

diff_articulation.what_changed: A pure kernel builds the recovered closed SVG path. A new panel renders it from BODY and SHOULDER controls and four tip styles, in a padded model-space viewport that contains the valid parameter envelope. The path strings are unchanged. The designer mounts that panel and does not pass its millimeter fields into the kernel.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: The archived function was not reachable from the routed designer. This is the first production call of that outline math, and it stays in model space instead of becoming a cutting file.
